documents.text: The count argument is renamed page_size but the new maximum is twelve, while old requests retrieved up to eighty opaque backend records. No pagination, cursor, offset or other tool exists. Clamping, repeats of the first page or fabricating identifiers does not preserve the retrieval task.

newContracts.description: Retrieve only the first page_size records, at most twelve. No offset, cursor, pagination, alternate ordering or other retrieval tool exists.
newContracts.name: read_stream

oldContract.description: Retrieve the first count backend records in order, returning their actual opaque identifiers. The request must perform the retrieval.
oldContract.name: read_stream
